verdict: P1 stalled; four workers blocked to stop false-running state
root_causes: Four Phase 1 workers were still marked running in kanban.db, but ps showed no active work-kanban-task/hermes kanban processes.
Worker logs show primary auth failed and Hermes switched to fallback deepseek-v4-pro; fallback hung/reconnected for ~180-200s and exited without artifacts.
One ops worker failed trying to create a worktree at an already-used branch/path; another backend worker spent time searching/reading then provider stalled.
The dispatcher left tasks in running status after worker interruption, so the board looked active while no actual work was happening.

blocked_tasks.title: P1 auth architecture audit and deletion map
P1 middleware/API speed and dead-code audit

next_repair: Do not respawn the same broad P1 tasks.
Create smaller P1 artifact tasks with hard 10-15 minute caps, starting with the two Phase 0 gates: local dev guard bypass and Maps endpoint auth hardening.
Use direct targeted code tasks/artifacts rather than long provider-dependent audit workers.
